Second test build for the October 2026 Clash of Clans UI. Use it instead of beta.1: with **Upgrade walls** on, beta.1 stopped the run with an error at the first wall pass.

- Walls work again, one at a time, and are paid only with the resource that is full or over your threshold.
- The Town Hall and the Builder Hall are never upgraded in Maxer mode, even when their name is read only in part.
- **Run until maxed** pauses again when both storages are full, and uses any builder or laboratory that frees up while it waits.
- "Connection lost" and "Anyone there?" are answered after a 3-minute wait (in case you are playing on another device).
- A popup with a gem on it is closed, never confirmed. A card that failed to start is left alone for 30 minutes.
- An error during a raid no longer ends the session: it counts as a failed raid. The Builder Base returns to its village after every raid and stops after four failures in a row. Multi-run skips an account it cannot switch to.
- The builder chips and the Builder Base troop cards are found at 16:9 too.

First run: Clash of Clans open in Google Play Games on the home village, **Auto upgrade** on **Dry run**, then **Start** and watch the Logs page for a few raids. Switch to **Maxer** once its picks look right.

Not tested in a full session yet, and 16:9 windows are checked on rebuilt screenshots only. If something goes wrong, send the log (Logs page) and the `debug` folder from `%LOCALAPPDATA%\BasePilot`.

Download **BasePilot.exe** (Tesseract is bundled); **BasePilot.exe.sha256** has its checksum. The exe is not signed, so SmartScreen warns: More info, then Run anyway. Botting breaks Supercell's terms of service and can get an account banned.
